status_legend.verified-full: full 2016-2026 record passed its verification vintage (new: holdout + audit; old: revisit audit passed)
status_legend.dev-only: frozen 2016-2023 development result only; no 2024-2026 holdout
status_legend.failed: full record exists but the strategy is below the bar, rejected, stale, or overlay-only without a frozen holdout

strategies.name: Always-long vol target
strategies.tagline: Holds TQQQ permanently and scales the position only by its own realised volatility.
strategies.summary: A pure volatility-target test with no trend, drawdown or crash gate: TQQQ weight is min(1, target/RV20). The 45% target clears the development bar but the frozen full run reaches 37.25% CAGR, 0.29 pp below TQQQ; the 50% variant that hit 37.95% failed the pre-cut weight test.
strategies.note: Repaired: build_weights derives the daily signal end from the last *completed* session. The 11:07 cut now ends the daily read on 2020-03-11, so the 11:06 bar carries the prior session's target and the cut is 0.0. Dev/full metrics are unchanged (39.204% dev; 37.253% full), weights are long-only and sum <= 1, and 2024-26 freshens (489 changes, 472 unique rows; mean TQQQ 82.7%).

strategies.name: Quiet capitulation reversal
strategies.tagline: Buys TQQQ after a quiet multi-horizon QQQ decline and holds one session.
strategies.summary: Triggers on a -3% 3-session, -5% 10-session or -8% 15-session QQQ decline on below-average volume, then buys TQQQ at the event close for one session. The 1 bp development result is 39.75% CAGR, but it fails at 5 bp and the 2024-26 holdout earns only 13.02%.
strategies.note: Full 2016-2026 record. Pre-cut weights bit-identical at 2020-03-12 11:07. Long-only, sum <= 1. 2024-26 weights freshen (86 changes, 2 unique rows; event sleeve on 3.7% of holdout bars). Dev slice reproduces result.json exactly.

strategies.name: Crash early-warning
strategies.tagline: De-risks TQQQ on a volatility, drawdown-acceleration and overnight-gap composite, then re-enters on a 10-day high.
strategies.summary: Moves to cash when a 5% QQQ drawdown is still deepening and either volatility is accelerating or gap stress is persistent, then re-enters after a 10-session high. It cuts the 2020 crash, but ex-2020 it earns 24.7% with about TQQQ's Sharpe, so the CAGR edge is a crash-hedge payoff.
strategies.note: The CAGR edge is a 2020 crash-hedge payoff; ex-2020 the strategy earns 24.7% with essentially TQQQ's Sharpe.

strategies.name: Cross-asset dual momentum
strategies.tagline: Rotates TQQQ, QQQ and BIL on multi-horizon QQQ-vs-cash and QQQ-vs-SPY momentum.
strategies.summary: Uses a 21/42-session absolute-momentum OR gate and a 42-session QQQ/SPY relative gate, with a volatility-targeted TQQQ sleeve. Revision 1 failed and Revision 2 was built after that failure; the full 30.58% CAGR and 9.23% holdout make it a fragile 2018/2022 avoidance bet.
strategies.note: Full 2016-2026 record. Pre-cut weights bit-identical. Long-only, sum <= 1. 2024-26 weights freshen (33 changes, 4 unique rows; mean TQQQ 58.5%). Dev slice reproduces result.json exactly.

strategies.name: Donchian two-sleeve trend
strategies.tagline: A fast 20/10 TQQQ Donchian sleeve plus a slow 100/50 QQQ regime sleeve, sized to an 85% vol target.
strategies.summary: The fast sleeve re-enters quickly after shakeouts while the slow QQQ regime keeps the book invested through multi-month trends. It passes development at 49.14% CAGR, but the 50-session slow exit is load-bearing and the 2024-26 holdout earns only 3.19%.
strategies.note: Full 2016-2026 record. Pre-cut weights bit-identical at 11:07. Long-only, sum <= 1. 2024-26 weights freshen (37 changes, 24 unique rows; mean TQQQ 79.2%). Daily-vs-minute mark difference explains the dev-number gap; no reproducibility failure.

strategies.name: Dual-momentum TQQQ
strategies.tagline: A 12-month QQQ-vs-cash and QQQ-vs-SPY gate on a volatility-targeted TQQQ sleeve.
strategies.summary: Holds TQQQ when absolute and relative momentum agree, QQQ when only absolute momentum is positive, and BIL otherwise. It clears development at 41.15%, but the 252-session lookback is load-bearing, the placebo misses its threshold, and 2018 is a full TQQQ drawdown.
strategies.note: One-shot full run after run_holdout's authorized dev-guard lift (module END/DEV_END). Dev slice reproduces result.json exactly (41.149% vs 41.15%). Pre-cut weights bit-identical, long-only, sum <= 1. 2024-26 weights freshen (57 changes, 50 unique rows; mean TQQQ 93.6%). Full-window 41.61% / 57.95% / 0.96 is above the TQQQ full bar, but this task does not promote it.

strategies.name: EMA ribbon trend
strategies.tagline: A 20/50/100 EMA ribbon with a 0.5% hysteresis band and an 85% vol target.
strategies.summary: Holds TQQQ when the ribbon is stacked, QQQ in ordinary pullbacks, and BIL below the 100-day EMA, with a buffered exit to avoid whipsaw. The hysteresis is worth about 10 pp of CAGR; without it the strategy earns 36.40% and fails, and 2022-23 is weak.
strategies.note: Without the 0.5% hysteresis the ribbon earns 36.40% and fails the bar; 2/30 shuffled placebos beat its CAGR and 2022-23 is weak.

strategies.name: Fast trend + vol target
strategies.tagline: A 20/50-session QQQ trend gate on TQQQ, sized to an 85% volatility budget with a fast crash brake.
strategies.summary: Holds TQQQ while the fast trend is up, scales inversely to realised TQQQ volatility, and exits on a 2.5% intraday stop with a five-session cooldown. The full-window edge is trend and crash timing; 2019 lost to TQQQ on both return and drawdown.
strategies.note: The 2019 range-bound bull was a severe whipsaw (+54.9% vs TQQQ +148.2% with a worse drawdown), so the pass is carried by 2020/2023 and by avoiding 2022.

strategies.name: FOMC + post-OpEx window
strategies.tagline: Owns TQQQ in the FOMC intermeeting drift and the post-OpEx flow window, with a volatility throttle.
strategies.summary: Holds TQQQ from FOMC decision +3 through +20 and from monthly OpEx +1 through +3, BIL otherwise, halving exposure when the 20/100-day realised-vol ratio exceeds 1.25. The calendar is hardcoded ex-ante through 2026; the return edge is concentrated in 2020-2023 and it lags calm bulls.
strategies.note: Full 52.77% / 42.60% DD / 1.29 Sharpe, holdout 40.99%; audit exact. 2020-2023 concentrated; ex-2020 only about 0.8 pp above the dev bar. Vol throttle is a sizing overlay, not the edge.

strategies.name: Close-momentum weakness exit
strategies.tagline: A vol-targeted TQQQ core that goes to cash for 24 hours after a negative full intraday return in an elevated-vol tape.
strategies.summary: The return engine is continuous vol-targeted TQQQ; a negative QQQ open-to-close return while 10-day vol is at least 20% triggers a one-day cash exit. Dev CAGR is 46.21%, but the holdout is flat at 0.00% daily and the full 31.21% is entirely a 2016-2023 phenomenon.
strategies.note: Repaired: _daily_vol now reads through the panel's actual last completed session instead of hardcoded DEV_END=2023-12-29, and _session_indices drops a partial final session. The 2024-26 sleeve trades again (188 changes, 114 unique rows; mean TQQQ 86.5%) and the cut is 0.0. Dev is unchanged at 46.208%; full is 37.478% / 54.375% / 0.932, 0.06 pp below the TQQQ full bar. Weights are long-only, sum <= 1.

strategies.name: FOMC intermeeting drift
strategies.tagline: Holds TQQQ only from the third to the twentieth session after each scheduled FOMC decision.
strategies.summary: The claim is that the equity premium is earned in the middle of the FOMC cycle, after the two-day post-decision unwind and before the next meeting's de-risking. It passes development at 51.06%, but the full 37.09% misses the bar by 0.45 pp and ex-2020 CAGR is about 33.4%.
strategies.note: Repaired: added ex-ante scheduled FOMC decision dates through 2026-09-16 (the 2026-10-28 meeting is after the 2026-10-23 panel end). Dev-panel result is unchanged at 51.061%; full 2024-26 now trades the FOMC windows (45 changes, mean TQQQ 57.3%). Cut remains 0.0. Full is 44.391% / 57.194% / 1.063, above the TQQQ full bar but not promoted. Weights are long-only, sum <= 1.

strategies.name: Walk-forward ML regime
strategies.tagline: A quarterly walk-forward logistic model of TQQQ path-drawdown risk, gated by multi-horizon momentum.
strategies.summary: Refits a logistic classifier every quarter to estimate the probability of a >15% TQQQ drawdown over the next 20 sessions, holding TQQQ only when momentum is up and model risk is low. The ML adds little over a simple rv5<0.60 rule (91% same decisions), and the 2024-26 holdout is nearly constant risk-off.
strategies.note: A simple rv5<0.60 rule matches 91% of its decisions; 2016 is cash during warm-up and the 2024-26 holdout is nearly constant risk-off (3.66%).

strategies.name: Momentum + crash brake
strategies.tagline: A loose 20/60-session momentum gate with an explicit fast-drawdown crash brake and a 5-day-high re-entry.
strategies.summary: Holds TQQQ while either momentum horizon is positive, overrides to cash on a fast 20-day drawdown plus a vol-spike or 3-day-loss confirmation, and re-enters on a 5-day high with positive 20-day momentum. It wins 2020 and 2022 and loses every other year; the full 35.61% misses the bar.
strategies.note: Full 2016-2026 record. Pre-cut weights bit-identical. Long-only, sum <= 1. 2024-26 weights freshen (32 changes, 2 unique rows; mean TQQQ 84.5%). Dev slice reproduces result.json exactly.

strategies.name: Opening-range breakout
strategies.tagline: A TQQQ opening-range breakout confirmed by volume and ATR, flat every night.
strategies.summary: Buys a gap-up opening-range breakout when opening volume is in a normal-to-expanded band and the range is a small fraction of ATR, with an ATR-scaled stop and a close exit. Dev CAGR is only 17.89% at 1 bp (11.33% at 5 bp), far below the bar, so the idea is retained as a negative result.
strategies.note: Repaired: build_weights now accepts a full-panel TQQQ bars frame, and run_holdout.py calls the optional build_holdout_weights() hook. Dev is unchanged at 17.895%; full is 14.992% / 21.376% / 0.914; 2024-26 freshens (394 changes, mean TQQQ 20.3%). Cut is 0.0 using only bars through 11:06. Weights are long-only, sum <= 1.

strategies.name: Overnight drift filter
strategies.tagline: A close-anchored TQQQ position sized by 10-day vol and halved below the 20-day SMA.
strategies.summary: Holds TQQQ through the overnight block and the next session, scaling to min(1, 0.20/vol) and halving exposure when QQQ is below its 20-day average. The full 37.07% CAGR misses the bar by 0.47 pp, and the 2022 drawdown is 58.35%.
strategies.note: Full 2016-2026 record. Pre-session prefix is exact; the only 11:07 difference (3.8e-3) is confined to the final partial bar, where the 15:58 decision rule writes the truncated session's 11:05 close as if it were the 15:58 close. This is a final-session boundary artifact, not price look-ahead. Long-only, sum <= 1; 2024-26 weights freshen strongly (275 changes, 185 unique rows; mean TQQQ 79.5%). Dev slice reproduces result.json exactly.

strategies.name: Overnight + intraday trend
strategies.tagline: A 20/50-session trend holds the overnight, while a 0.6% intraday stop cuts the session's left tail.
strategies.summary: Starts each session long TQQQ when the 20/50 trend or a 50-day reclaim is intact, exits intraday on a 0.6% QQQ decline, re-enters on a reclaim, and skips the night if stopped and not reclaimed. Dev CAGR is 64.63%, but it fails at 10 bp (33.84%) and it is dev-only.
strategies.note: One-shot full run. Dev slice reproduces result.json exactly (64.631% vs 64.631%). Pre-cut weights bit-identical, long-only, sum <= 1. 2024-26 weights freshen (384 changes, 2 unique rows; mean TQQQ 66.5%). Full-window 56.62% / 35.66% / 1.32 is above the TQQQ full bar, but this task does not promote it.

strategies.name: Pre-holiday drift
strategies.tagline: Holds TQQQ for the three sessions before every scheduled NYSE holiday.
strategies.summary: Tests the classic pre-holiday effect in a 3x fund, with a vol throttle that halves TQQQ above the trailing 75th percentile. The window is statistically indistinguishable from random (t=0.52), the best grid cell is 15.5 CAGR points short, and the result is 4.23% dev.
strategies.note: Repaired: added the 2024-26 scheduled NYSE holiday calendar and made _pairs() suppress holidays after the panel's last session. Dev-panel result is unchanged at 4.231%; full 2024-26 trades the pre-holiday windows (58 changes, mean TQQQ 9.4%). Full is 6.820% / 31.216% / 0.494; cut is 0.0. Weights are long-only, sum <= 1.

strategies.name: QQQ/SPY relative ladder
strategies.tagline: A four-state leverage ladder driven by QQQ/SPY 126-day relative momentum and the QQQ 150-day trend.
strategies.summary: Moves between 3x TQQQ, a 2x TQQQ/QQQ blend, 1x QQQ and cash as Nasdaq leadership and trend change. The relative gate adds only +0.019 Sharpe and costs 2.3 pp of CAGR; replacing 2022 with TQQQ drops the full CAGR to 22.8%.
strategies.note: The relative gate adds only +0.019 Sharpe and costs 2.3 pp CAGR; replacing 2022 with TQQQ drops the full CAGR to 22.8%.

strategies.name: TQQQ/QQQ relative value
strategies.tagline: Holds TQQQ while the TQQQ/QQQ ratio momentum is intact and falls back to QQQ when leverage is being repriced.
strategies.summary: Uses 100-session ratio momentum and QQQ 20-day realised vol to decide whether 3x compounding is being paid for, staying fully invested in TQQQ or QQQ. The ratio signal is 99.7% explained by QQQ trend and variance; it is a leverage-cycle meter, not independent alpha.
strategies.note: The ratio momentum is 99.7% explained by QQQ trend and variance, and 2022 is worse than QQQ; it is a leverage-cycle meter, not independent alpha.

strategies.name: SPY-confirmed trend
strategies.tagline: A QQQ 150-day trend ladder that requires SPY above its 200-day SMA before using 3x leverage.
strategies.summary: Holds TQQQ only when both QQQ and SPY are above trend, QQQ when only QQQ is, and BIL otherwise, with an 85% vol target and a -15% from-20-day-high brake. Dev CAGR is 50.36%, but the literal mandate centre (100-day QQQ, -10% brake) fails at 20.64%, and it is dev-only.
strategies.note: One-shot full run after run_holdout's authorized dev-guard lift (the module's own _check_dev_boundary is written to be lifted). Dev slice reproduces result.json exactly (50.362% vs 50.362%). Pre-cut weights bit-identical, long-only, sum <= 1. 2024-26 weights freshen (48 changes, 20 unique rows; mean TQQQ 82.1%). Full-window 47.57% / 43.27% / 1.13 is above the TQQQ full bar, but this task does not promote it.

strategies.name: 52-week-high trend
strategies.tagline: Holds TQQQ while QQQ is within 8% of its 52-week high and above its 20-day average.
strategies.summary: A 52-week-high proximity gate with a 20-day trend confirmation, a 20-day closing-low exit, a -10% drawdown stop and an 85% vol target. The 8-11% entry band is a ridge, removing the 52-week gate drops dev CAGR to 32.41%, and 2023 lags badly.
strategies.note: The 8-11% entry band is a ridge (5% fails), removing the 52-week gate drops dev CAGR to 32.41%, and 2023 is +63.8% vs TQQQ +204.9%.

strategies.name: Fast-drawdown brake
strategies.tagline: Defaults to TQQQ, exits on a 14% five-session loss, and re-enters on a 15-session high.
strategies.summary: A fast crash exit paired with a deliberately slow re-entry: the 15-day high is what avoids bear-market rallies and catches the durable leg of a V recovery. Dev CAGR is 52.83%, but the exit alone sells into bounces and the worst drawdown is a 2018 whipsaw.
strategies.note: One-shot full run. Dev slice reproduces result.json exactly (52.829% vs 52.829%). Pre-cut weights bit-identical, long-only, sum <= 1. 2024-26 weights freshen (13 changes, 2 unique rows; mean TQQQ 76.1%). Full-window 50.72% / 45.90% / 1.16 is above the TQQQ full bar, but this task does not promote it.

strategies.name: Aggressive vol target
strategies.tagline: Always-long TQQQ at an 80-100% vol target with a linear 6-12% drawdown brake.
strategies.summary: Holds TQQQ permanently, scaling by min(1, target/RV20) and cutting to a 25% floor as the 15-day drawdown widens from 6% to 12%. Dev CAGR is 40.16%, but it underperforms TQQQ in every bull year and needs 30.51% holdout CAGR to clear the full bar.
strategies.note: One-shot full run. Dev slice reproduces result.json exactly (40.156% vs 40.156%). Pre-cut weights bit-identical, long-only, sum <= 1. 2024-26 weights freshen strongly (705 changes, 647 unique rows; mean TQQQ 77.8%). Full-window 37.17% / 57.77% / 1.00 is below the TQQQ full bar.

strategies.name: Turn-of-month
strategies.tagline: Holds TQQQ in the last five and first six sessions of each month.
strategies.summary: A pure calendar tilt around the month boundary, with no trend or price signal and BIL outside the window. Dev CAGR is 41.41% and full is 33.62%; the 11-session window is wide and the holdout earns only 16.00%.
strategies.note: Repaired with an optional ex-ante calendar parameter. The full-panel record is unchanged (41.409% dev; 33.621% full; 69 changes, mean TQQQ 52.8%). The 11:07 audit now passes calendar=full sessions and gives 0.0; the earlier 1.0 was the truncated panel mistaking 2020-03-12 for month-end. Weights are long-only, sum <= 1.

strategies.name: Vol-of-vol risk timing
strategies.tagline: Uses Parkinson range vol, vol-of-vol and a 20-day level ladder to time TQQQ exposure.
strategies.summary: De-risks when volatility is high, accelerating or unstable, and re-risks when high vol is decelerating with vol-of-vol falling from its peak. The full 42.17% CAGR passes, but 2022 contributes about 200% of the net log excess and de-risking cuts only 0.65 pp of drawdown.
strategies.note: 2022 contributes about 200% of the net log excess; de-risking cuts only 0.65 pp of drawdown and the strategy is not a tail hedge.

strategies.name: Volatility term structure
strategies.tagline: Splits TQQQ between a 165-day trend sleeve and a RV20/RV60 term-structure sleeve with an acute-spike kill.
strategies.summary: Holds half the book on the QQQ trend and half on a calm vol term structure, drops to cash when short/long vol spikes, and sizes the remainder to the regime. The term structure buys drawdown and Sharpe, not raw CAGR; a 3-session delay drops dev CAGR to 33.6%.
strategies.note: A 3-session execution delay drops dev CAGR to 33.6%; the term structure buys drawdown/Sharpe, not raw CAGR over a simpler trend+spike rule.

strategies.name: Ratio froth
strategies.tagline: The legacy round-1 leader: a 165-day QQQ trend base with a 4% stop and a TQQQ/QQQ ratio-froth overlay.
strategies.summary: Holds TQQQ while QQQ is above its 165-day SMA, with a 4% intraday stop and a ratio-froth downgrade. The overlay alone earns 60.15% CAGR with a 53.31% drawdown, so the base and stop do most of the work and the ratio threshold was chosen post hoc.
strategies.note: Lead clean rerun; dev 61.56%, holdout 64.88%, full 62.21%; audit exact.

strategies.name: Intraday 60-minute trend
strategies.tagline: QQQ's 60-minute EMA cross measures intraday trend persistence; hold TQQQ only while that trend is up.
strategies.summary: An intraday-only, trend-tiered TQQQ position designed to be independent of the overnight base. The pre-registered intraday-only version earns 5.4% at 1 bp and -16.7% at 5 bp; the shipped overnight variant's 28.8% is 90% TQQQ overnight drift.
strategies.note: Verified against the published pre-tune freeze; current code is a later variant. Published curve unchanged.

strategies.name: OpEx cycle
strategies.tagline: Owns the OpEx cycle but steps out of the monthly expiry session.
strategies.summary: Holds TQQQ around the monthly option-expiry cycle and goes to BIL for the expiry session itself, on the claim that dealer roll and gamma unwind create a recurring negative intraday drift. The 26.9% dev CAGR is almost all TQQQ beta; the expiry premium is about 1%/yr and permutation p=0.245.
strategies.note: Frozen-code full rerun reproduces the published curve exactly (0.00 pp CAGR/DD, 0.000 Sharpe).

strategies.name: Post-capitulation reversal
strategies.tagline: Buys TQQQ at the next open after a >=3% intraday QQQ capitulation and sells before that close.
strategies.summary: The trade is a one-session liquidity-provision premium after forced selling, with no overnight exposure. There are 88 events at +0.99% (p=0.068), the 3.0% threshold is a peak, and 2022-23 is negative.
strategies.note: Frozen-code full rerun reproduces the published curve exactly (0.00 pp CAGR/DD, 0.000 Sharpe).

strategies.name: Time-of-day leverage ladder
strategies.tagline: A weekly 3x/1x/0x ladder on the overnight-minus-intraday spread and the first-hour return.
strategies.summary: Goes to TQQQ when both time-of-day signals are above their 26-week medians, QQQ when one is, and BIL when neither is. The first-hour signal is inverted in its own diagnostics (true -1.19 bp vs false +68.79 bp), and the 0.616 correlation to the old base fails the independence rule.
strategies.note: Frozen-code full rerun reproduces the published curve exactly (0.00 pp CAGR/DD, 0.000 Sharpe).

strategies.name: Close-flow exhaustion
strategies.tagline: Buys the 15:59 print after an orderly QQQ decline and owns the one-session reversal.
strategies.summary: QQQ down more than 1% by the close is treated as forced leveraged-ETF selling, so TQQQ is bought at the closing print and held for the next session. The 275-event edge is +70 bp, but the overnight leg is negative and the edge is next-day dip-buying; 10 bp CAGR falls to 7.6%.
strategies.note: Frozen-code full rerun reproduces the published curve exactly (0.00 pp CAGR/DD, 0.000 Sharpe).

strategies.name: Relative Nasdaq flow dip
strategies.tagline: Buys TQQQ for three sessions when Nasdaq underperforms SPY at the close.
strategies.summary: Treats a z-score below -1.25 in the QQQ-SPY daily relative return as temporary leveraged-ETF and flow pressure that reverses over three sessions. The 13.2% dev CAGR is only the 72nd percentile of a random-entry placebo, and hold=3 is a cliff.
strategies.note: Frozen-code full rerun reproduces the published curve exactly (0.00 pp CAGR/DD, 0.000 Sharpe).

strategies.name: Unsupervised regime allocator
strategies.tagline: An unsupervised k-means regime allocator across TQQQ, QQQ and BIL.
strategies.summary: Clusters short-horizon market-state features and maps each cluster's past forward return to TQQQ, QQQ or BIL. It behaves like QQQ with a worse Sharpe (0.81 vs 0.90), and the "unsupervised" label is misleading because the cluster-to-asset map is fitted on forward returns.
strategies.note: Corrected monthly-refit curve 17.93% replaces the frozen 2023-12 extension.

strategies.name: Leverage-decay timing
strategies.tagline: A walk-forward classifier of TQQQ-vs-3xQQQ decay that rotates between TQQQ, QQQ and BIL.
strategies.summary: Times 3x leverage by predicting worst-quartile five-session TQQQ decay, holding TQQQ when the path is smooth and BIL when it is not. The TQQQ-vs-QQQ decay difference is only 1-2 bp (p=0.47), and a simple 20-day vol rule earns Sharpe 1.13 versus 0.81.
strategies.note: Frozen-code full rerun reproduces the published curve exactly (0.00 pp CAGR/DD, 0.000 Sharpe).

strategies.name: Night continuation / day reversal
strategies.tagline: Night continues an up day; the day reverses a down night, sized by a 3-sigma gap budget.
strategies.summary: Uses block-conditional positions to capture the overnight and intraday premia without a moving-average regime. The predictor is a ~7-year EWMA rather than yesterday's sign (F1 t=0.23), and a static vol-matched mix dominates.
strategies.note: Frozen-code full rerun reproduces the published curve exactly (0.00 pp CAGR/DD, 0.000 Sharpe).

strategies.name: Ratio-cycle standalone
strategies.tagline: A TQQQ/QQQ ratio-cycle meter that holds QQQ by default and adds TQQQ only after a deep ratio discount turns up.
strategies.summary: Treats the ratio as a leverage-cycle gauge: cash or QQQ in ratio froth and variance expansion, a bounded 40% TQQQ sleeve after a deep discount turns. About 90% of the book is QQQ and 97.8% of ratio extension is explained by QQQ trend plus variance, so it is not a standalone relative-value premium.
strategies.note: Frozen-code full rerun reproduces the published curve within 0.01 pp CAGR/DD and 0.006 Sharpe.

strategies.name: Volatility-state risk parity
strategies.tagline: Equal-risk QQQ/TQQQ composition with a risk budget that rises after transient vol spikes.
strategies.summary: Applies HRP/equal-risk sizing to the QQQ/TQQQ pair and BIL, with a risk budget conditioned on whether a vol spike is transient or persistent. QQQ/TQQQ correlation is 0.999, so this is really a leverage choice; only 8 spike events and Sharpe 0.69 is below QQQ's 0.92.
strategies.note: Frozen-code full rerun reproduces the published curve exactly (0.00 pp CAGR/DD, 0.000 Sharpe).

strategies.name: Closing-pressure overnight carry
strategies.tagline: Holds the overnight and first-30-minute block only after a sold close.
strategies.summary: The claim is that the overnight block pays more after closing pressure, so the strategy conditions on the last-30-minute QQQ return and a self-referential vol gate. The filter destroys the premium it claims to time: unconditional every-night earns 35.0% versus 19.7% conditional.
strategies.note: Frozen-code full rerun reproduces the published curve exactly (0.00 pp CAGR/DD, 0.000 Sharpe).

strategies.name: Vol-scaled crash system
strategies.tagline: Always-long TQQQ with inverse-vol sizing and a one-sided ATR stop that never widens past 4%.
strategies.summary: Holds TQQQ permanently, sizes inversely to ATR and exits to BIL for the rest of the session and the night when the ATR-scaled barrier breaks. It cuts the full-window drawdown to 37.88% but keeps 72% TQQQ time and 0.755 daily correlation, so it is a risk overlay rather than a diversifier.
strategies.note: Shared OHLC/ATR adapter; dev 57.84%, holdout 34.89%, full 51.46% 1 bp / 51.32% daily-close; audit exact.

strategies.name: Session-timing TQQQ
strategies.tagline: Holds TQQQ from late afternoon through the overnight and opening drive, skipping midday and weak-close nights.
strategies.summary: Enters at 14:30 when TQQQ is up on the session, otherwise at 15:59, holds through the overnight and the next 09:30-10:00, and exits at 10:00; size is scaled by QQQ 10-day vol. The edge is the overnight/opening-drive premium, not a daily trend.

strategies.name: Short-term reversal
strategies.tagline: Buys TQQQ after a two-session down streak or a 3-session drop of at least 1.5%, then holds for a rolling five-session rebound.
strategies.summary: A short-horizon mean-reversion strategy: QQQ down two sessions or down 1.5% over three sessions at the close triggers a TQQQ entry at the next open; the exit rolls forward if another dip signal fires. No trend, stop or vol target in the primary.
strategies.note: Full 49.54% / 66.46% DD / 0.99 Sharpe, holdout 62.12%; audit exact. The rolling exit chains dip clusters (mean 9.2 sessions), 2022 loses 62.8%, and the DD is high; stops/vol sizing did not improve it.

strategies.name: Rebalance-flow de-risk
strategies.tagline: Goes to BIL after a large up day with a strong last 30 minutes, when leveraged-ETF rebalancing is most likely to reverse.
strategies.summary: A mechanical flow strategy: after a big QQQ up day whose last 30 minutes are also up, TQQQ closes with forced rebalancing demand and tends to reverse; the strategy sits in BIL for the next session, otherwise holds a 50%-vol-target TQQQ position.
strategies.note: Full 45.55% / 50.92% DD / 1.07 Sharpe, holdout 34.89%; audit exact. 5 bp dev 47.13%, 10 bp 42.88%; 8/8 grid cells and placebo p=0.02. Still a 3x flow beta, not independent alpha.

The strategy is a short-rate liquidity-stress overlay, not an all-weather policy-liquidity regime. The term-structure signal did not anticipate the slow 2022 bear market: it reacted to vol spikes, re-entered on calm, and was whipsawed through the H1 2022 bear rallies. The edge is a handful of large regime calls (2018, 2020, 2022 relative), not a consistent monthly timing rule. It should go to a one-shot holdout only as a diversifying regime overlay, not as a crash shield.
